ORDER % 20.04.2023 Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
Let requisite compliances be made within 01 week.
The application stands disposed-of.

By way of the present petition filed under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, the petitioner seeks regular bail in case FIR No. 476/2019 dated 20.09.2019 registered under section 306/376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S.: Tilak Nagar.
2.
At the outset it is noticed that the mother of the deceased has been made respondent No.2 in the present matter, which is not warranted in law.
Accordingly, upon an oral request, respondent No.2 is deleted from the array of parties.

3. Let amended memo of parties be filed before the next date.
4. Issue notice.
5. Mr. Shoaib Haider, learned APP appears for the State on advance copy; accepts notice; and seeks time to file status report.

6. Let status report be filed within 06 weeks; with copy to the opposing counsel.
7. Let updated nominal be requisitioned from the Jail Superintendent for the next date.

8. Re-notify on 26th May 2023.
9.

Let intimation under section 439(1-A) Cr.P.C. read with the Delhi High Court Practice Directions dated 24.09.2019 in form Annexure-A attached to the Practice Directions, be sent by the Investigating Officer to the complainant, informing her that she is entitled to be heard in the present bail petition, for which she may remain present (either in-person or via video-conferencing) or be represented on the next date.

10. In view of what has been pointed-out by Mr. Jatan Singh, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, it is made clear that if the complainant remains unrepresented on the next date, the court will proceed with the matter regardless.
